# LaunchWeek

> LaunchWeek is a free guide collection for launching a SaaS product in 5 days. 33+ step-by-step go-to-market guides covering positioning, distribution, pricing, landing pages, and growth — built for indie hackers and vibe coders.

## Sections

- [Home](https://launchweek.ai) — Overview and guide index
- [Positioning](https://launchweek.ai/positioning) — Define your product's market position and messaging
- [Distribution](https://launchweek.ai/distribution) — Channels, launch tactics, and audience-building
- [Pricing](https://launchweek.ai/pricing) — Pricing strategy and packaging for SaaS
- [Landing Pages](https://launchweek.ai/landing-pages) — Landing page copy, structure, and conversion tips
- [Growth](https://launchweek.ai/growth) — Post-launch growth tactics and retention

## Quick Links

- All guides: https://launchweek.ai
- Sister site (build): https://vibeweek.ai
- AI model reference: https://llmreference.com

## Key Facts

- Free, no sign-up required
- 33+ guides covering the full SaaS launch playbook
- Companion to VibeWeek.ai (VibeWeek = Build, LaunchWeek = Launch)
- New guides added regularly
